resumos: Biblioteca pura Python para busca full-text que oferece BM25, stemming, acentos e facilita a criação de índices locais para uso com agentes de IA.
Pure-Python full-text search library supporting BM25F, stemming, and accent folding, usable as Haystack backend.
Pure‑Python search library implementing BM25 with support for custom analyzers, ideal for keyword search with Portuguese accents and stemming.
